answer: Hardware-Bound Enclave Execution Attestation An identity gains network access only by submitting a cryptographic receipt generated inside a secured processor kernel, proving its execution runs on unique silicon. To bypass this, an attacker must deploy dedicated physical microchips for every single false persona. The cost is absolute capital expenditure in foundry fabrication and raw hardware, matching the physical expansion rate of a dissolving karst landscape rather than free digital replication. A compromised raven node loses its attestation key forever.
